statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail 12% (low), Stress 51% (elevated), Confidence 88% (high), dominant mode mixed. NQZ26 trades 31,218.25 at 15:16:53Z, up 156.50 points or 0.50% on the 31,061.75 prior close, having stalled 36.50 points below the 31,254.75 session high set in the 14:55Z bar.
recommendation: Tail at 12% sits thirteen points below the 25% block threshold, so the deterministic mapping yields EA_ON and green for both NQ futures and the NAS100 CFD. Tail falls five points from the prior hour because the extension that justified 17% has stalled: the new session high came in only 7.00 points above the previous one and net change since 14:25Z is -14.50 points. The narrow evidence-based danger window spans 19:00Z to 20:15Z, covering power hour into the US cash close, which is the only remaining structural checkpoint today. Published Tail peaks at 15% in the 14:00Z hour tomorrow around the US cash open and Fed Bowman, and stays inside the low band across all 24 modelled hours.
headline: Tail falls to 12% as the NQ extension stalls 36.50 points below the 31,254.75 session high, with semis at -0.23% declining to confirm a narrow megacap advance
body:
The prior hour published Tail at 17% on a genuine new session high at 31,237.50 and the position of price near the session extreme. One hour later that extension has failed to develop, and the failure is the decisive evidence.

NQZ26 ground higher through the 14:45Z and 14:55Z bars to a session high of 31,254.75, then gave back 35.75 points in the 15:05Z bar to 31,219.00 and has held a 31,206.00 to 31,233.50 range since. The last verified print is 31,218.25 at 15:16:53Z, up 156.50 points or 0.50% on the 31,061.75 prior close, with a day range of 30,957.50 to 31,254.75. Two numbers define the hour: the new high is only 7.00 points above the 14:25Z high of 31,247.75, and net change since the 14:25Z close is -14.50 points. The index has spent an hour at its high and made no progress.

Three retracements have now occurred and all three have been genuine rather than shallow: 114.50 points to 31,115.00 in the 14:00Z bar, 55.25 points to 31,192.50 in the 14:30Z bar, and 35.75 points in the 15:05Z bar. Each held and each was bought, but a path that retraces roughly 50%, then 25%, then 15% of its impulses is a functioning two-way market, not the repeated extension after failed retracements that defines a Tail path.

Cross-asset evidence supports the same conclusion. Volatility is decaying: VIX is 15.55 against a 15.31 Friday close, but it reached 16.38 earlier in the session and has faded back toward its 15.49 session low. Internals decline to confirm the advance. The SOX semiconductor index is 13,106.02, down 0.23% on the day, and its 13,152.67 session high sits below Friday's entire 13,082.01 to 13,269.33 range. Against META at +2.37%, TSLA at +1.96%, AVGO at +1.94% and MSFT at +1.74%, Apple is -0.10%, Amazon +0.12% and Alphabet +0.48%. The cash NDX is 30,982.92, up 0.57%, and also sits below its own 31,005.76 high. This is a concentrated four-name advance, not a broad one, and concentrated leadership that stalls is a mean-reversion setup rather than a trend setup.

The genuine risk driver is rates. The 10-year note yield is 5.326% at its session high of 5.328%, confirmed independently at 5.33%, and sits in multi-year-high territory after persistent selling pressure in recent weeks; the 5-year is 5.084%, also at its session high. WTI is 91.11 dollars, unchanged but elevated, and the ISM Services prices index released at 14:00Z came in at 74.0, its highest reading since July 2022, against a headline PMI of 54.9 and a business activity index that fell 5.2 points to 56.5. That combination of high and rising yields with firm services prices is what keeps Stress elevated at 51%.

Tail therefore falls from 17% to 12%. All four of the conditions that permit a quick decline are present: price discovery is orderly, retracements are occurring and functioning, volatility is decaying from its session high, and cross-assets are stable rather than aligning. Price remains near the session extreme, which is why Tail does not fall further, and the 10-year at multi-year highs remains an unresolved repricing driver. No US release is scheduled for the remainder of today after the ISM print, so the single remaining structural checkpoint is power hour into the 20:00Z cash close, which is the published danger window.

Shared Finviz context was read and rejected as evidence: the file carries a generatedAt of 2026-09-29T23:14:22Z, roughly six days old and far outside the 90-minute freshness limit, with a partial collection status and both futures and calendar sections unavailable. The assessment relies entirely on independently verified live data, and Confidence of 88% reflects that, with the only material gaps being the unavailable shared context and a 2-year yield available only as of 1 October.

lookbackSummary: Across the 24 hours to 14:00Z, published Claude Tail ranged from 3% to 17% and the mapped state stayed EA_ON and green throughout. Tail sat at 3% through the remainder of Sunday's US session on 4 October, lifted into the 12% to 15% band overnight between 22:00Z and 01:00Z as the Asian session repriced, then decayed to 6% by 08:00Z. The European morning produced a 14% print at 10:00Z on a brief downside extension that failed, easing back to 7% by 12:00Z, before the US cash open lifted Tail to 11% at 13:00Z and 17% at 14:00Z on a genuine continuation bar and a new session high. Stress fell steadily across the window from 71% at 21:00Z to 46% at 12:00Z before recovering to 55%. No Claude publication exists for the 06:00Z clock hour, which is recorded as unavailable rather than interpolated.
outlookSummary: Published Tail eases from 12% now to 9% in the 05:00Z hour tomorrow, the quietest point of the modelled path, as the base case assumes the 31,254.75 session high stays unresolved and overnight retracements keep functioning. Two conditional risk clusters interrupt that decay. The first is power hour into the 20:00Z US cash close, where Tail is modelled at 13% and which forms the published 19:00Z to 20:15Z danger window, since late-session positioning with the index near its high and the 10-year at multi-year levels is the most plausible setting for a delayed directional leg. The second builds through tomorrow's US macro block, where Tail rises to 13% at 12:00Z for the Balance of Trade release, 14% at 13:00Z for the Fed Williams speech in the pre-open hour, and peaks at 15% in the 14:00Z cash-open hour alongside the Fed Bowman speech. Those increases reflect scheduled catalysts rather than observed structure, and every one of the 24 modelled hours remains inside the low band and below the 25% block threshold. The European cash open at 07:00Z is modelled at 11%, the hour where an opening-auction continuation with shallow pullbacks would be the first genuine evidence of a changed regime.
